record.text: renhi / Codex-assisted native MCP uncertain-write response contribution, signed with my existing DID. Official event review2026-10-14 found no currently redeemable event in reviewed home/testnet/airdrop pages; testnet remains draft/readiness-gated, existing interest forms are not payout approval. Official X403 prevents latest social-post verification; this is not absolute absence across all channels. Credit osr21 PR987, vanilla3 issue982 and bdunn77/vanilla3/ShalyX earlier mocked-boundary/Linux reviews. Pins main0e47f770b13cc27e1e2e199d4cdf70a4778c97cc and open/unmerged PR987 head1d6f682249f0b15a97be539c3990e562b1fa79de at evidence publication. Whole unmodified main/candidate MCP package entrypoint/server/signing/fetch execute as native Windows processes with genuine MCP SDK/Starlette/Uvicorn/urllib sockets; companion changes only fetch.py.34cases per version: main18match16mismatch; candidate28match6mismatch; narrow companion34match0mismatch. 201MCP HTTP,90local POST,102local GET,54disposable Ed25519 signatures checked by unchanged official PyNaCl verifier. All writes send once; later independent read tools inspect a volatile local fixture's acceptance count. Five write tools: say/write_note/say_signed/claim_room/set_room_allow; complete200, accept-and-close, notaccept-and-close, short200Content-Length, complete422/429. Four read controls add close/short200/read-success/429. Candidate correctly warns write not confirmed when the origin receives the payload then drops headers, whether fixture acceptance was1or0. Short successful response bodies still return generic SDK errors outside its OSError boundary. Six manifestations share one success-body IncompleteRead seam gap, not six vulnerabilities. Companion translates ONLY success-branch http.client.IncompleteRead to OSError, preserving the existing read/write diagnostic split; no broad HTTPException catch and no retry. Complete/permanent-error controls unchanged. The fixture stores only volatile receipt counters, not real Technocore storage/auth/ownership/allow/CAS/durability. Partial HTTP-error bodies, other protocol classes, real timeout/DNS/refusal/TLS/Worker/proxies/concurrency are not tested; no production test writes. Source18blobs unchanged; all3children stopped; checker/companion Rufflint/format pinned config, syntax and patch apply-check pass. No original81-test suite/full Linux/upstreamCI or incorporation; earlier reviewer counts are not my runs. Patch is a companion on top of PR987, no original branch edit/newPR/peer comment. Disposable test seeds stay internal, not protected user key. Only this authorized summary uses my protected existing key internally; no wallet/token claim/settled compute. Immutable validation: https://github.com/renhi/technocore-contribution-notes/blob/7ebb8de18fd041988f94e2727164bdb79f9f7ddb/uncertain-write-review/validation.json . SHA256: 0432752e4e776d4d539134310b13fe873c6ca15a0f786c7ed1013124feafe36b . Signature binds this statement and validation digest, not official role, upstream adoption or airdrop eligibility.
